title: A Cre-Lox P Recombination Approach for the Detection of Cell Fusion In Vivo
protocol: Harvest mesenchymal stem cells when they are 70 - 80% confluent with 1X trypsin for 5 min.
Inactivate trypsin with α-MEM complete medium (antibiotic free).
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 300 x g for 5 min.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 1 mL of 1X PBS.
Count cells using a hemacytometer.
Transfer 1.5 x 106 cells to a 1.5 mL centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge at 300 x g for 5 min.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 300 μL of R Buffer.
Mix with 6 μg (2 μg / 5.0 x 105 cells) of p231 pCMVe-betaAc-STOP-luc plasmid.
Place 3 mL of E Buffer into the electroporation docking port per manufacturer's protocol.
Transfer cell-plasmid solution to a 100 μL Neon pipet tip and electroporate with a pulse duration of 20 ms and a magnitude of 1500 volts.
Place electroporated cells into a 15 mL conical tube containing 9.7 mL α-MEM complete medium.
Repeat step 1.5 two additional times and pool transfected cells to yield a total volume of 10 mL.
Add the 10 mL cell suspension (1.5 x 10^6 cells) to a T175 flask containing 10 mL α-MEM complete medium.
Change α-MEM complete medium 24 hours following transfection.
Harvest transfected cells when 70 - 80% confluent (~2 - 3 days after electroporation).
Perform cell count using a hemacytometer and resuspend the cells at a concentration of 1.0 x 10^6 cells/50 μL of α-MEM complete medium.
Induce anesthesia by isoflurane on transgenic mice engineered to constitutively express Cre recombinase in every cell.
Remove hair from chest region using hair clippers or chemical hair remover.
Intubate with an 18 gauge catheter and place on mouse ventilator at 120 - 130 breaths per minute with a stroke volume of 150 μL.
Make lateral incision across the fourth intercostal space thereby producing a thoracotomy.
Visualize the heart.
Make two 25 μL injections of transfected cell suspension using a 1 mL syringe and 28 gauge needle.
Bend the needle head ~90 degrees to ease intramyocardial injection and prevent excessive damage.
Close the ribs and muscle layers with absorbable sutures (e.g., vicryl).
Suture skin closed using 4-0 nylon or silk.
Allow mouse to recover from anesthesia and extubate.
Inject Cre mice receiving medium injections only with appropriate controls.
Inject Cre mice receiving the same concentration of untransfected cells as a control group.
Inject wild type mice receiving transfected cells for alternative control.
Induce anesthesia on mice via isoflurane at 4% for induction.
Maintain anesthesia with 1 - 2% isoflurane.
Intraperitoneally inject 10 μL per gram of mouse body weight of 15 mg/mL D-Luciferin.
Place mice supine in imaging box with facemask administering 1 - 2% isoflurane for maintenance anesthesia.
Image sham control mouse alongside experimental mice for easy comparison.
Using Living Image software, set appropriate exposure time.
Set area of image to fit mice and keep consistent throughout imaging.
Set subject height at 4.5 cm.
Acquire luminescence intensity signal corresponding to mouse or mice within the view field.
Save unmodified image files.
Process images to remove background signal corresponding to a control mouse.
Conduct intensity analysis using Living Image software or open source image analysis software.
Select a region of interest (ROI) for comparing intensity data between animals and experiments.
Deliver 1 x 10^6, 1 x 10^3, or 1 x 10^1 cells of the 231-LUC-D3H1 cell line constitutively expressing luciferase into the myocardium of C57/Bl6 mice.
Inject intraperitoneally with luciferin six hours after cell delivery in mice.
Image using the Xenogen Biophotonic Imaging System to detect signal intensity from injected cells.
Transfect MSCs with the LoxP-Stop-LoxP-Luciferase plasmid and deliver them to Cre-expressing mice myocardium.
Image mice without D-luciferin injection approximately one week after cell delivery using the Xenogen system.
Inject intraperitoneally with D-luciferin in mice for imaging using the Xenogen system.
Detect signal corresponding to luciferase intensity and thus cell fusion.
